reuse.why: Uses the small existing helpers (assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse, bankSync.syncAccount), but the tree has no shared link/download routine and the change does not create one; it clones the Akahu flow instead.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (~75 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions/downloadPluggyAiTransactions with only the server URL changed.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts its provider equivalent: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config, type in types/models.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the two client edits (readable name, fintegra:false) are minimal and needed for the exhaustive Record types even though the client is out of scope.

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the link and download pattern means every future fix to account linking or response handling must be made in yet another place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link/download abstraction exists in this tree; the change uses the existing small helpers rather than going around them.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount (app.ts) and downloadAkahuTransactions (sync.ts) are open, only renamed per provider, not disguised.
